.github/workflows/refresh-claim-evidence:
- 'lib/data-integrity.mjs'
      - 'scripts/verify-data-generation.mjs'
          manifest_url='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NinjaRK/abg-pulse/live-data/data/claim-evidence.manifest.json'
          published=false
            code=$(curl -L -sS --max-time 30 -H 'Cache-Control: no-cache' -o /tmp/published-claim-evidence.json -w '%{http_code}' "$url?run=$GITHUB_RUN_ID&attempt=$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT&probe=$attempt" || true)
            manifest_code=$(curl -L -sS --max-time 30 -H 'Cache-Control: no-cache' -o /tmp/published-claim-manifest.json -w '%{http_code}' "$manifest_url?run=$GITHUB_RUN_ID&attempt=$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT&probe=$attempt" || true)
            if [ "$code" = '200' ] && [ "$manifest_code" = '200' ] && node scripts/verify-data-generation.mjs claims-publication out/claim-evidence.json /tmp/published-claim-evidence.json > /tmp/claims-publication-proof.json \
              && node scripts/verify-data-generation.mjs claims-manifest out/claim-evidence.manifest.json /tmp/published-claim-manifest.json /tmp/published-claim-evidence.json > /tmp/claims-manifest-proof.json; then
              published=true
              break
            fi
            sleep 10
          done
          if [ "$published" != 'true' ]; then
            echo 'The exact claim graph generation/hash was not retrieved.'
            exit 1
          fi
          for attempt in $(seq 1 12); do
            code=$(curl -L -sS --max-time 30 -H 'Cache-Control: no-cache' -o /tmp/production-claims.json -w '%{http_code}' "https://abg-pulse-intelligence-v4.vercel.app/api/claims?summaryOnly=true&run=$GITHUB_RUN_ID&attempt=$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT&probe=$attempt" || true)
            if [ "$code" = '200' ] && node scripts/verify-data-generation.mjs claims-consumer out/claim-evidence.json /tmp/production-claims.json > /tmp/claims-consumer-proof.json; then
          echo 'Production did not demonstrate consumption of the exact claim graph generation.'
          name: claim-evidence-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ github.sha }}
            /tmp/published-claim-evidence.json
            /tmp/published-claim-manifest.json
            /tmp/claims-manifest-proof.json
            /tmp/production-claims.json
            /tmp/claims-publication-proof.json
            /tmp/claims-consumer-proof.json
- 'lib/data-integrity.mjs'
      - 'scripts/verify-data-generation.mjs'
          git fetch origin live-data
          git worktree add --detach /tmp/abg-snapshot-publish origin/live-data
          cp /tmp/live-snapshot.publish.json /tmp/abg-snapshot-publish/live-snapshot.json
          git -C /tmp/abg-snapshot-publish add live-snapshot.json
          git -C /tmp/abg-snapshot-publish commit -m "Refresh ABG Pulse snapshot $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%MZ')"
          for attempt in $(seq 1 6); do
            if git -C /tmp/abg-snapshot-publish push origin HEAD:live-data; then
              exit 0
            fi
            git -C /tmp/abg-snapshot-publish fetch origin live-data
            git -C /tmp/abg-snapshot-publish rebase origin/live-data
            sleep $((attempt * 5))
          done
          echo 'Snapshot publication failed; do not claim a successful refresh.'
          exit 1
            code=$(curl -L -sS --max-time 30 -H 'Cache-Control: no-cache' -o /tmp/published-snapshot.json -w '%{http_code}' "$RAW_SNAPSHOT_URL?run=$GITHUB_RUN_ID&attempt=$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT&probe=$attempt" || true)
            if [ "$code" = "200" ] && node scripts/verify-data-generation.mjs snapshot-publication /tmp/live-snapshot.json /tmp/published-snapshot.json > /tmp/snapshot-publication-proof.json; then
              published=true
              break
            echo 'The exact snapshot generation/hash was not retrieved.'
            code=$(curl -L -sS --max-time 45 -H 'Cache-Control: no-cache' -o /tmp/production-scan.json -w '%{http_code}' "$PRODUCTION_SCAN_URL?start=$start&end=$end&run=$GITHUB_RUN_ID&attempt=$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT&probe=$attempt" || true)
            if [ "$code" = "200" ] && node scripts/verify-data-generation.mjs snapshot-consumer /tmp/live-snapshot.json /tmp/production-scan.json > /tmp/snapshot-consumer-proof.json; then
              exit 0
          echo 'Production did not demonstrate consumption of the exact published data generation.'
          exit 1
          name: abg-pulse-live-snapshot-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
            /tmp/snapshot-publication-proof.json
            /tmp/snapshot-consumer-proof.json
